architectural_constraints: Wasmtime memory_init_cow shares initial eligible module memory images, not arbitrary live Store state.
Wasmtime 48.0.5 source explicitly states memory_init_cow unsupported on Windows; initialization copies bytes.
Wasmtime Module/Component serialization is compiled code, not runtime state; deserialization of untrusted artifact bytes is unsafe.
Fuel is an execution budget within a pinned profile, not a wall-clock guarantee or a cross-version constant.
Host imports, allocation policy, checkpoint boundaries and recorded effects must be specified by ChronosOS.
Iroh 1.3.0 internally uses noq 1.3.0; Quinn is an alternative and its types are not interchangeable.
N0DisableRelay still uses public lookup; private tests use Minimal and explicit loopback socket addresses.
SQLite bundled version 3.53.2 verified in libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2 sqlite3.h; WAL is local persistence, not replication.
Persistent hash maps do not supply canonical durable Merkle node bytes.
Thousands of branch descriptors are distinct from thousands of active browser or Wasmtime instances.
